verdict.rationale: Documenting which TypeScript versions are officially supported is a fair question for a React framework, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack names supported TypeScript versions or a compatibility matrix. A community remark calling Next.js an 'isomorphic TS framework' says nothing about version support, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I know which TypeScript versions the framework officially supports so I can avoid compatibility breaks when upgrading either one
